tasks.title: Add fetch_program_team() two-SELECT aggregation service
tasks.notes: ProgramTeamRow/ProgramTeamResponse added to app/schemas/program_detail.py, field order locked per FR-2. fetch_program_team(db, program_id, range_value): SELECT 1 = program_members roster (user_id, name, role) WHERE program_id=:pid; SELECT 2 = usage_events aggregate (user, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions, SUM(tokens) AS tokens) WHERE program_id=:pid AND ts>=:range_start GROUP BY user, using ix_usage_events_program_id_user_ts. Merge in Python by user_id/user (D-01) -- members with zero in-range rows excluded. avg_tokens_per_session = round(tokens/sessions) server-side, int not float; sessions=0 guarded (no ZeroDivisionError -- excluded per active-in-range contract, sessions=0 cannot occur for an included row). Order by tokens DESC. Docstring notes the two-SELECT strategy and the new index dependency (Documentation requirements).

tasks.title: Register GET /api/overview/program-detail/{program_id}/team on the overview router
tasks.notes: Fifth sibling route. range: str = Depends(_range_with_default) (reused verbatim from the module). Calls await program_visibility(current_user, program_id) once; no ProgramSummary existence lookup, no 404 (matches PGD-02/04, not PGD-03's 404 precedent -- team is an activity aggregate, not a program-identity lookup). Emits one program_team_fetched structured log (method, path, program_id, range, status, latency_ms) via time.perf_counter(), mirroring program_commands_fetched. No persona branching anywhere in the handler (AC-6/AC-8 byte-identical invariant).

tasks.title: Register GET /api/overview/program-detail/{program_id}/team/{member_id}/usage sibling route (popup backend)

On pass, imports and calls SHP-02's own three service functions directly (app.services.personal_usage) with member_id as user_id, returns PersonalUsageResponse verbatim -- no reshaping (AC-10). range: str = Depends(_range_with_default), same shared wrapper. Zero edits to app/api/personal_usage.py or app/schemas/personal_usage.py.
